errors.evidence: This information is not present in the figure or its caption ('Training Status Table'). It appears to be taken from the title of the paper the figure is from, which is external context not verifiable from the image itself.
At 25,000 statements, the data point is visibly above the 1.5 line on the y-axis, closer to 1.6.
At 55,000 statements, the data point is visibly below the 1.0 line, at approximately 0.8. The value 0.9 is an inaccurate approximation.
The line is not a smooth curve; it is a series of straight line segments connecting discrete data points (piecewise linear).
